mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO t_device_realtime (device_id, metrics, alarm_level, update_time) VALUES
(#{item.deviceId}, #{item.metricsJson}::jsonb, #{item.alarmLevel}, #{item.ts})
ON CONFLICT (device_id) DO UPDATE SET metrics = excluded.metrics, alarm_level = excluded.alarm_level, update_time = excluded.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT r.device_id, r.metrics::text AS metrics_json, r.alarm_level, r.update_time FROM t_device_realtime AS r WHERE r.device_id = #{deviceId}
